limitations: Public signed-out rendered UI only; three symbols not full market.
UTC observed_at is actual capture time, not exchange event time. Display timezone unverified.
Historical candles selected before currently developing candle; finality and exact UTC boundaries not independently verified.
USD OI not quantity OI; capture times of UI fields are asynchronous.
Trading-data URL retains JCTUSDT query after selected-symbol change; selected_symbol and tooltip quantity units verified.
Historical bars may be published after the hour; early JCT capture ends18:00, later updates19:00.
No execution eligibility or account state inferred.
Both KAIA OI tooltips resolved same18:00 point; no hourly OI change calculated. Historical1h candle captured17:00, not latest18:00.
